clips.title: The story
paras: Concerned by the prolonged absence of an elderly recluse, Elaine Carevin in Darkshire asks travelers to check on him. The lonely old man, Abercrombie, lives in a rickety shack perched right on the edge of Raven Hill Cemetery.

In a beleaguered settlement like Darkshire, it is easy to lose track of eccentric loners until their absence becomes alarming. Elaine Carevin recalls an old man who once regularly trekked into town for provisions before abruptly vanishing from sight. Given the relentless dangers haunting the roads of Duskwood, she directs wandering adventurers to inspect his shack overlooking the haunted expanse of Raven Hill Cemetery to make sure he hasn't met a grim fate.

Reaching the lonely hut reveals that its resident, an old man named Abercrombie, is still among the living. He chuckles softly at the mention of the Carevins, claiming that his long absence is merely the consequence of advancing age and the treacherous monsters prowling the woods. Relieved to find an able traveler at his door, Abercrombie wastes no time in asking whether they might run a few helpful errands for him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elaine Carevin? Hehe, oh yes... Of course, the Carevins.
No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
